title: Knock Control System Error
shortDescription: A general fault in the knock control system has been detected by the PCM.
fullDescription: The engine control module detected a malfunction in the knock control system that prevents proper ignition timing adjustment. The knock control circuit monitors and compensates for engine knock, and a failure may lead to reduced power and potential engine damage.
safetyImpact: Reduced power and possible engine damage if knock is not corrected.

fixSteps.title: Scan for codes
fixSteps.instruction: Use an OBD-II scanner to read all stored and pending codes plus freeze frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect the related sensor and harness for damage, oil contamination, or loose connectors.

fixSteps.title: Test sensor circuit
fixSteps.instruction: Use a multimeter to verify reference voltage, ground, and signal continuity per the wiring diagram.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the failed sensor or coil with an OEM-quality part. Torque to spec, clear codes and verify with a test drive.
